versionGroups.label: Peer dependencies describe what the host provides and are left as written.
The package's updater writes the overrides that install local npm packages.

semverGroups.label: The local Pi SDK packages depend on these exact versions. pnpm resolves a caret range to the newest release, so a range would install a second copy with its own module state.
LogTape keeps its configuration in module state, so every workspace member has to load the same copy. With a caret range, pnpm can lock a newer release for one member while another keeps the old one.
